question: Can the alternative produce the correct business record for difficult bankruptcy documents with an acceptable correction cost?
comparators: DaData generic extraction with an adequate declared schema
A configured alternative with comparable rules
Client's actual PAU/Rafinad/manual workflow when access is authorised
fairness: Same permitted input documents, field definitions and client-specific business rules
Distinguish ready-to-use product results from results after engineering/tuning; record tuning effort separately
Do not reuse benchmark holdout documents to tune either implementation
Ground truth reviewed by a knowledgeable human, disagreements recorded before scoring
Begin with synthetic or properly anonymised samples; no private client files sent to another provider without authorised data handling

critical_cases.scenario: Original claim, revised claim, partial rejection and final inclusion coexist
critical_cases.check: Use the final accepted components; exclude rejected parts and do not substitute an earlier requested total

critical_cases.scenario: Principal, interest, sanctions, old costs and newly awarded duty appear together
critical_cases.check: Assign components according to the agreed output contract; do not double-count the total; verify cent-exact arithmetic

critical_cases.scenario: Several creditors, debtors or cited proceedings occur in one document
critical_cases.check: Amounts, identifiers and decisions belong to the correct participant and current proceeding

critical_cases.scenario: Pledge is requested, declined, deferred or accepted for only part of the claims
critical_cases.check: Do not infer acceptance from the word pledge; distinguish mixed claims and request review when needed

critical_cases.scenario: Historical dates, procedure end and hearing/report directions coexist
critical_cases.check: Use the right event and conditional rule; a calculated procedure date is not automatically a scheduled hearing

critical_cases.scenario: A value is absent, ambiguous or contradictory
critical_cases.check: No invented value; explicit uncertainty/manual review preserves the usable fields

metrics: Critical semantic errors by case type
False automatic acceptance of wrong records
Minutes to a checked record in the client's system
API spend, engineering effort and review/support cost separately
decision: Only a successful common-contract test supports a comparative accuracy/cost claim. Different feature lists and per-page prices alone do not. A paid pilot must test the customer's actual unresolved step.
caution: Configured deadline offsets and EMU amount-field semantics are client contracts, not universal statements of Russian law.
